caption:
The start of a new year invites reflection, not expectation.

It’s a moment to pause. Not to fix yourself or rush into change, but to take stock of what’s carried you here and what you want to hold onto as you move forward.

The past few years have been heavy for a lot of people. Things haven’t always been easy, and priorities have shifted in ways we didn’t expect. Through all of that, many of you have continued to walk through our doors, message us, talk with our team, and trust us with something personal. We don’t take that lightly.

If you’ve been with us for a while, you’ll likely recognise faces in our shops or have spoken with members of our team, and some of you know our owners too. Those conversations matter to us. We’ve seen people come in unsure and leave more confident. We’ve watched customers grow, change, and settle into themselves. Over time, many of those interactions have turned into genuine relationships, and in some cases, real friendships.

Scandals is an independent UK business. We’re rooted in our local community and proud to employ people from the area we call home. The people you speak to aren’t scripts or bots. They’re real, thoughtful, and genuinely care about doing things properly. Respect, honesty, and trust aren’t marketing ideas for us. They’re how we try to work every day.

Over the last year, we’ve been more careful about how we operate. We’ve chosen to focus on what we do well and let go of things that stretched us too thin. Protecting the wellbeing and energy of our team has been a priority, because when people feel supported, they show up better for each other and for you.

That approach has paid off. Despite a tough economic climate, this has been our strongest year in recent times. Not because we chased growth for the sake of it, but because we stayed steady, made thoughtful choices, and built on the trust we’ve earned together.

Looking ahead, our intention is simple. We’ll keep listening. We’ll keep improving. And we’ll continue bringing in new products and ideas that feel right, chosen with care, inclusivity, and real lives in mind.

Cont. in comments

HAUTE COUTURE 🪡 + VOCAL 🎵 GEOMETRY = @ana.schurmann.couture . Did you know that the shape of my logo is actually my voice? 🎵🪡
Vocês sabiam que a logo da minha marca é a geometria da minha voz? 🎵🪡

Yes, sound can organize matter into geometric
patterns through resonance. The logo is based on a Chladni pattern, a well-documented physical phenomenon in acoustics and vibration science.

First described in the 18th century by physicist Ernst Chladni, these patterns emerge when a rigid surface—such as a metal plate—is vibrated at specific frequencies. Fine particles like sand or salt migrate to the nodal lines, areas of minimal displacement, making the vibrational modes of the surface visible.

Each frequency produces a unique geometric pattern, shaped by the material’s properties, boundary conditions, and the applied sound wave. Chladni patterns are widely used in physics, acoustics, and engineering to study resonance, wave behavior, and modal analysis.

For this experiment, I performed a controlled vocal test, singing directly into a Chladni setup. My voice acted as the excitation source, transferring acoustic energy into the plate. When the system reached resonance, the vibration stabilized into a diamond-shaped nodal pattern.

This outcome aligns with established physics: at resonance, energy organizes itself into stable, repeatable geometries rather than random motion.

That diamond-shaped pattern—generated by my own voice—became the logo of my brand.
It is not a metaphor, but a direct visual trace of acoustic resonance.

The Lighthouse • Winter 26

For Winter 26, we ventured across land and sea to the lighthouse - a magical and almost mythic place on the Scottish Isle of Skye.

Standing amid jagged rocks, framed by mountains on a headland, we found our inspiration in Ornsay Lighthouse. With its masonry tower and galley, lantern and keeper’s house, it was the lighthouse we had pictured in our dreams.

Coincidentally, Ornsay’s cottages were once owned by the author, Gavin Maxwell, whose novel ‘Ring of Bright Water’ has long been one of our favourites.

Come with us as we explore Skye’s mesmerising waters, its labyrinthine lochs, sea arches, craggy shores and towering cliffs.

如果你早已對人逼人的熱門景點感到疲勞，想找一個真正能「靜下來」的地方，英國北部這片森林或許正是答案。

位於英格蘭最北的 Kielder Forest，近日獲《國家地理》（National Geographic）選為 2026年全球最佳旅遊冒險體驗，同時亦是全歐洲最大、最高級別的 Gold Tier 國際暗夜公園。

在城市長期被燈光包圍的年代，能夠真正看見星空，本身已成為一種奢侈。Kielder Forest 正是少數仍保留極低光害的地區之一，夜空清澈得幾乎能用肉眼看見銀河，讓人重新感受宇宙的廣闊與自身的渺小。
《國家地理》指出，2026 年的旅遊趨勢不再只是「打卡式度假」，而是那些會在心裡留下痕跡的體驗——多日徒步、修復身心的自然旅程，以及能讓人真正抽離日常節奏的地方，而 Kielder Forest 正正符合這種深度旅行的想像。

在森林裡看星星　不是科幻，是日常
森林內的 Kielder Observatory是這趟旅程的核心亮點。天文台全年舉辦約 700 場觀星及教育活動，由專業團隊帶領，適合不同年齡層參加，即使對天文一竅不通，也能輕鬆投入。

《國家地理》形容，觀星活動往往持續至凌晨，靠的不只是望遠鏡，還有工作人員滿滿的熱情，以及一杯杯熱朱古力，在寒夜中陪伴大家仰望星空。

Kielder Forest 不單是歐洲最大 Gold Tier 暗夜公園，同時亦是全球第三大受保護暗夜保留區，不論是攝影愛好者、星空迷，還是單純想遠離城市噪音的人，都能在這裡找到屬於自己的節奏。

住在星空之下　把旅程慢下來
除了自然景觀，區內亦設有多間專為旅人而設的住宿與餐飲空間，包括 Battlesteads Hotel & Restaurant、The Twice Brewed Inn，以及位於 Derwent Valley 的 Lord Crewe Arms，讓旅程不只停留在「看風景」，而是真正住進北英格蘭的夜色之中。

Kielder Observatory 的門票由 £25 起，全年開放，適合不同季節造訪。對於想嘗試小眾旅遊、避開人潮，又希望在自然中重新充電的旅人而言，這片暗夜森林，或許正是 2026 年最值得出發的地方。

Tag someone who needs a little hint on how to support a breastfeeding mama… because these small things go a long way:

1️⃣Bring her a hot drink – feeding a baby is thirsty work, and there’s nothing better than a warm cuppa you didn’t have to make yourself ☕️ 

2️⃣ Take her food – snacks, meals, even a slice of cake. If she’s feeding, she’s probably not feeding herself & did you know breastfeeding mommas need 300-500 extra calories per day 😋 

3️⃣ Buy her a proper nursing bra – because comfort is everything when you’re feeding around the clock 👙 

I’ll be honest – I tried to save money early on with cheap nursing bras and totally regretted it. They offered no support, left me feeling sore, and definitely didn’t make me feel good.

Comfort while breastfeeding is non-negotiable 🤭
